quest.title: Question and Answer
quest.description: Swan does everything by the book — specifically, by the Knights of Favonius Handbook. Previously, Swan wouldn't ask anything of the Traveler, who was not a Knight then. Now that the Traveler is an Honorary Knight, Swan will sometimes quiz the Traveler concerning the contents of the Handbook.
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x1200, White Iron Chunk x3, Mora x1200, White Iron Chunk x1, Mora x1000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ask away.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: As expected of our Honorary Knight, you do seem confident.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wow, the Knights are so strict...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: You got them all correct. As expected of our Honorary Knight — such questions were no problem for you at all.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: To be honest, there are some locals who can't answer some of these questions.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Please, take this as a gift.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Librarian

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Cavalry Captain

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Outrider

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Now, please listen to my questions.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Do you remember Miss Lisa? Hahaha, well, if you've ever failed to return books to the Library of the Knights of Favonius on time, you'll remember her for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: My question is this: what is Miss Lisa's official title in the Knights of Favonius?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Library Administrator

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Purple Teacher

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: You answered correctly. Miss Lisa's official title is indeed that of "Librarian."

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: How do you do, Honorary Knight? Have you been reading the Knights of Favonius Handbook carefully?

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Like the last time, I have a few questions here for you. These questions cover some content from the handbook, as well as some common-sense questions.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Depending on how you answer, I'll also be giving you a small gift.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I need to read it a little more...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Don't worry, take as much time as you need.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Hmm, are you sure that you remember this correctly? Miss Lisa's official title should be "Librarian."

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Now for my next question.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: I'm sure you're familiar with Mr. Kaeya. He does often make a deep impression.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Here's my question: what is Mr. Kaeya's official title in the Knights of Favonius?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Knight Captain

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Master's Adjutant

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Correct — Mr. Kaeya's official title is indeed "Cavalry Captain."

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Mr. Kaeya's official title should be "Cavalry Captain" instead.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Now for my last question.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: You've definitely met Miss Amber before, haven't you? I'm sure her passion was most memorable indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: So my question is this: what is Miss Amber's official title as a Knight of Favonius?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Gliding Champion

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Scout

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Precisely — Amber's official title is "Outrider."

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Are you sure you have that right? Miss Amber's official title is "Outrider."

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Alright, that was all from me. Let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wow, the Knights are so strict...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Hmm... Unfortunately, you didn't answer them all correctly.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: But I think that you did a good job, considering the circumstances. Please take this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wow, the Knights are so strict...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Hmm, I think it best that you read the Knights of Favonius Handbook again.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: You are an Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius, after all. It wouldn't do if you weren't familiar with Mondstadt at all.
